items.quote: You can build software that manages accounts from the customer level down to the keyword level.
items.why: Quote covers account-to-keyword management only; no mention of assets or reporting.

items.quote: Just like other Google APIs, Google Ads API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization.
items.why: Quote directly states OAuth 2.0 used for authentication and authorization.

items.quote: Developer tokens were sunset on September 9, 2026.
items.why: Quote states sunset date, but claim's main point is auth methods, which it doesn't address.

items.quote: After you've enabled Google Ads API, your Google Cloud project is granted Test access.
items.why: Quote shows Test access granted; does not state admin_approval gate or other tiers.

items.quote: Completing brand verification for your Google Cloud project is a prerequisite to apply for Basic access level.
items.why: Quote states brand verification prerequisite for Basic; not the admin_approval gate overall.

items.quote: If you need Standard access, you need a manual review.
items.why: Quote states Standard needs manual review; the broader gate claim is not shown.

items.quote: The Google Ads API can be called either using gRPC or REST.
items.why: Quote supports REST/gRPC callability; breadth and sdk_only are not addressed.

items.quote: The Google Ads MCP Server exposes MCP Tools and MCP Resources backed by the Google Ads API.
items.why: Quote shows an MCP Server exists; vendor-official status and URL not stated.
